result.rationale: The migration inserts `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts (host, ...) VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"` verbatim, bypassing the model's before_validation stripping. Since the old setting accepted URL-form hosts (spec fixtures show 'http://discourse.org' and 'https://example.com/1234' were valid embeddable_hosts values), and `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host` matches `where("lower(host) = ?", uri.host)`, a migrated host stored as 'http://discourse.org' would never match referer host 'discourse.org', silently breaking embeds for those sites after upgrade.
